instruction: Use `cms_product_record.xlsx` on the Desktop as a checklist. Fill its Value column with the current CMS details for `Joust Duffle Bag`, then save the spreadsheet. Use username `admin` and password `admin1234` to access the CMS admin site.
gt_steps: Open the self-hosted CMS admin site in Google Chrome.
Sign in to the CMS admin site.
Open the product catalog without editing any product data.
Open `cms_product_record.xlsx` from the Desktop in LibreOffice Calc.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `ID` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `Thumbnail` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the standard value `Joust Duffle Bag` for `Name`.
Enter the standard value `Simple Product` for `Type`.

result.command: C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python310\python.exe -c "from openpyxl import load_workbook; from pathlib import Path; p=Path.home()/'Desktop'/'cms_product_record.xlsx'; wb=load_workbook(p, data_only=True); ws=wb.active; print('\n'.join(f'{ws.cell(1,c).value}: {ws.cell(2,c).value}' for c in range(1, ws.max_column+1) if ws.cell(2,c).value is not None and str(ws.cell(2,c).value).strip() != ''))"
